title: 42 Arnold Street MAP01 source-driven reconstruction — AI handoff
purpose: Engine-independent MAP01 handoff for another AI to build into a Doom II/GZDoom IWAD. No APK or Android engine is included.

house.facade: cream horizontal weatherboard, dark tiled hip roof, brick chimney on right/east, covered porch, black metal front rails/gates
house.driveway: east/right side, concrete, covered carport continuing toward rear
house.rear: enclosed veranda/sunroom, patio, long grass yard, large shed

textures.H42KTCH: timber kitchen cabinetry + brown marbled benchtop + cream backsplash
textures.H42WIND: dark glazed window with pale frame

flats.H42ROAD: patched residential asphalt distinct from driveway concrete

confidence.exterior_site: high relative geometry from supplied aerials/front photo

builder_rules: Dad starts in the backyard. Do not move MAP01 player start to the front of the property.
Sam must visibly flee from the backyard through the rear house, hall and front door, then west/up Arnold Street into the Collenso-side playground.
MAP01 must not finish at the house or property boundary; the exit is inside the playground.
Keep the usable dark front door and small doorbell beside it.
Keep physical notes/clues small and domestic-scale; readability comes from interaction text, not billboard-sized sprites.
Preserve domestic scale and the room/door sequence.
Do not replace the house with generic Doom tech/hell textures.
Use source-matched H42 textures for MAP01.
Keep the right-side driveway/carport, long backyard, large rear shed, no.44/no.40 massing, Arnold Street, Collenso Street, reserve and playground.
Refine only when the supplied walkthrough/aerial evidence supports a correction.
Keep the Workmate in the 42 Arnold driveway and do not replace it with a generic sedan.
Keep the bins at the Arnold Street kerb/nature strip, not in the backyard.
Do not remove the suburban trees, shrubs, street lamps/poles, neighbour cars or playground props when importing MAP01.

accuracy_notes: No.44 is between 42 Arnold and Collenso Street.
No.40 is immediately east/right of 42 Arnold.
39, 37 and 35 are represented opposite Arnold Street.
Playground is in the reserve at the Arnold/Collenso side and is not connected to the backyard.
Footpaths and grass nature strips are separately represented from the asphalt carriageways.
Neighbour roofs are given separate material IDs so the other AI can keep the satellite colour differences.
The 42 Arnold driveway now contains a dedicated white single-cab tray Workmate-style ute, aligned north-south with the driveway.
Three wheelie bins are placed on the Arnold Street nature strip close to the kerb rather than inside the yard.
Outdoor surfaces are split into distinct lawn, verge, footpath, driveway, road and garden-bed materials so the block reads more like the satellite/reference images.
